name: pigi.finance
focus: Cumulative protocol ratings: a 0–100 score (higher = safer) and a band A–F per protocol node, published as 0.6 × pigi’s rating of the node plus 0.4 × the TVL-weighted mean of the scores of the rated vaults that deposit into it.

status.rule: pigi grades A to F and describes each band: A “strongest structural safety”, B “sound design with limited, identified weaknesses”, C “meaningful structural or operational concerns”, D “serious weaknesses or an active red flag”, F “failing”. A–B read as positive, C as neutral, D–F as negative.
